summary.en: Gauges self-test: each needle flings round the full arc lighting its ticks, springs back past its value and settles, the gauges a few frames apart; each value pops as its needle lands.
summary.zh: 仪表点火自检：每根指针先甩满整条弧、扫过的刻度依次点亮，再弹簧回落、过冲一下停在读数上；几块表错峰几帧，指针落定同帧数值弹出。

fits: Opening a dashboard section or revealing several readings at once: the scale first, then the values.
notFor: A single headline number (use digit-roll or tape-run); values that are not shares of a known scale.

intent.en: Show the full scale before the reading, so the viewer feels how big the number is; a ceremony of systems coming online.
intent.zh: 先亮量程再报数，让观众感到数字有多大；系统就绪的开场仪式感。

content.en: 2–4 readings that are shares of a known scale, each with a short name (≤ 12 chars); optional title and status.
content.zh: 2–4 个有明确量程的读数，各带一个短名称（≤ 6 字）；标题与状态可选。

fits.zh: 仪表盘开场、一次揭晓几项指标：先量程、后数值。

notFor.zh: 单个大数字（用 digit-roll 或 tape-run）；没有量程的数值。

pairs.note: a headline number after the gauges settle

en: Hold every needle dead still ≥ 1 s after it settles; drift reads as a bug.
Stagger the gauges a few frames; launched together they read as copies, not a wave.
zh: 指针落定后至少锁死 1 秒，尾漂像 bug。
几块表错开几帧起动；同时起动读成复制，不是一道波。

upstream.name: 满弧扫针自检
upstream.summary: 指针去程 ~12f ease-out 甩满弧，回程 ~20f 带 5-8° 过冲回摆落真值；多表错峰 3-5f；落定同帧盘下数值弹出
upstream.use: dashboard 开场仪式/性能指标揭晓；A 多表盘开机感，B 单指标大跳变

overlaps.note: a ring of numbers sweeps and its answer flies into the title; needle-sweep keeps the dial and moves a needle over it
